messages:
marta: Quick heads-up 1: Acme trial kickoff today at 16:00. They want a 3-week POC for search + summarization over support docs. Need final hosting choice and measurable success criteria before kickoff.
elaine: timeline looks tight. do we have EU residency constraints from legal?
sam_customer: yes 1: legal mandates EU-only data residency for this POC. also require customer-managed KMS and 12mo audit logs.
raj: EU-only narrows options: hosted-eu (if we can offer customer KMS), Dedicated in eu-west with CMK, or Private on their VPC. tradeoffs: hosted = fastest; dedicated = predictable throughput & SLA; private = max control but longer setup.
marta: can dedicated be spun up within 10 business days? that's their hard constraint.
elaine: likely yes if we allocate an existing reserved pool and use our quickstart images. private commonly needs 2-3 weeks with infra handoff.
tessa_security: received their security questionnaire. major asks: KMS integration, long-term audit logs, SOC attestation, network isolation. we need to confirm which options support customer KMS.
raj: Dedicated supports customer KMS via cloud KMS integration. Hosted-eu currently uses Redwood-managed keys only. Private supports customer KMS/HSM.
sam_customer: hosted without CMK is a non-starter for legal.
marta: that rules out hosted unless they explicitly waive CMK. next: success metrics we should propose. keeping it measurable:
``
- Search Precision@5 >= 0.75 on a 250-prompt eval set
- Summary ROUGE-L avg >= 0.62 on 100 manual checks
- 95th pctl chat latency <= 250ms for <512-token responses
- Per-query token cost <= $0.015 target
- No data egress outside EU
- Integration: demo SDK auth + sample end-to-end call by day 7
- Logs retained 12 months
```
elaine: good set. I'll build the eval harness and seed prompts. can they share sample docs now so we pre-index and run baseline evals?
sam_customer: sending a 10k-doc sample via SFTP in ~30m. legal will return an answered SQ within 48h.
raj: infra action items: 1) verify eu-west Dedicated capacity and provide cost estimate; 2) prepare KMS onboarding checklist; 3) set canary/fallback routing to smaller model if latency/throughput issues; 4) confirm audit log storage cost for 12mo.
marta: buyer asked for a firm quote for the 3-week trial + expected monthly committed pricing for Dedicated. can finance approve a trial credit?
josh-finance: we can grant trial credits to cover infra + support for 3 weeks. for committed pricing, we'll provide a tiered template with commit levels and discount brackets.
tessa_security: note re: SOC2: we can provide current SOC2 report for hosted/dedicated, but private deployments may require customer-specific attestation steps. flag for compliance.
raj: small blocker: hosted default audit retention is 90 days. Dedicated can be configured for 12 months with storage pass-through. confirm this to customer.
marta: plan to present two recommended paths to customer: (A) Dedicated-eu with CMK + 12mo logs (recommended)  timeline ~10 days; (B) Private on their VPC with CMK + 12mo logs  timeline 2-3 weeks, higher ops. ask them to confirm preference and push SFTP link ASAP.
sam_customer: we prefer Dedicated-eu if you can guarantee CMK + 12mo logs. please send a quote and onboarding checklist. thanks! :raised_hands:
elaine: will assemble quote + onboarding steps (KMS onboarding, role mapping, network allowlist, eval runbook). posting here when ready and looping in @raj @tessa_security @josh-finance.
infra-bot: Reservation check: eu-west cluster slot available (x1)  hold for 24h with `reserve-cluster --id eu-west-01 --ttl 24h`
marta: great, I'll message customer with the two options and next steps. thanks team.
